page_title: WHU 1-1 AST | West Ham v Aston Villa 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+11' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for West Ham due to a handball in the build-up play.
90+7' Wait! Referee Jarred Gillett has indicated he is going to review the West Ham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90+6' The ball finds its way to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 2:1.
90+3' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+3' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
87' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
86' The referee is firm and issues Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) a deserved yellow card.
86' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
84' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Emerson will be replaced by Aaron Cresswell (West Ham).
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lucas Paqueta walks off the pitch to be replaced by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
83' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
83' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa).
81' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Aston Villa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Moussa Diaby, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 1:1.
75' The corner from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola.

75' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' 11:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
72' Emerson (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

72' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends in a direct shot from a dangerously positioned free kick. The ball sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.

69' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Alphonse Areola!
69' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

69' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Michail Antonio.
63' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) replacing Morgan Rogers.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch for Alex Moreno.
62' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

62' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
61' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
61' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.
60' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from West Ham comes to nothing.
56' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' Aston Villa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' An attempted cross from Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
51' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
51' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Aston Villa.
50' The goal by West Ham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
50' The West Ham players halt their celebrations as referee Jarred Gillett makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
48' Michail Antonio (West Ham) was in the right place to put the ball into the back of the net with his body. It's 2:0.
48' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner.
48' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for West Ham.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jhon Duran is replaced by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa).
46' Unai Emery makes a half-time substitution. Matty Cash (Aston Villa) comes on in place of Clement Lenglet.
46' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
42' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Jarred Gillett due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) and his team.
42' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' Michail Antonio (West Ham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. West Ham earn a corner.
41' A first-time shot by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. The linesman makes the right call and West Ham will have a corner.
39' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
35' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

35' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
34' The Aston Villa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
29' 1 - 0 Michail Antonio (West Ham) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
28' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is flagged for offside.

26' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
24' Surely that's handball by one of the West Ham players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
22' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) launches a cross from the corner, but Emiliano Martinez is alert to thwart the effort.
21' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 30:70.
18' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alphonse Areola.
16' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
16' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Aston Villa have a corner.
14' The linesman signals that Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
13' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

13' A pass into the box finds Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alphonse Areola denies him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
11' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
11' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
10' Michail Antonio (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. West Ham force a corner. They send men into the box.
7' Aston Villa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
4' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Flag goes up against Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Aston Villa will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett is the one to supervise the game today.
